beats.name: Story Beat 1: Introduction to Viviana and Playful Pottery

cards.text: The music cuts out cleanly as Viviana introduces herself and her book Playful Pottery directly to camera
Establish an inviting, warm tone and set up the subject matter and title of the book right away without background distraction.
The documentary begins with the slow smile B-roll shot of Viviana
The upbeat background music plays during this opening visual moment.

beats.name: Story Beat 2: Clay Knowledge and Technique

cards.text: In spoken silence with no background music, Viviana explains that she wants the book to serve as a practical reference guide for foundational clay knowledge
Immediately following her dialogue, cut to footage of Viviana shaping clay on the pottery wheel
Demonstrate the hands-on craft and process behind the pottery guidance she shares in the book.
Bring the upbeat music bed back in across this wheel-shaping montage

beats.name: Story Beat 3: The Core Message — Creativity and Kindness

cards.text: The music cuts out as Viviana delivers the core emotional message behind the book, expressing her wish for readers to be creative and kind to themselves
Highlight the deeper purpose and artistic philosophy of self-compassion embedded in the book.
Immediately following this statement, cut to detailed B-roll of painting a handle on a ceramic piece
The music re-enters during the painting footage

beats.name: Story Beat 4: Studio Wrap-up and Outro

cards.text: Conclude the film with the shot of Viviana leaving the studio space
Provide a satisfying and uplifting closure to the profile.
The music continues playing over the final visuals and resolves cleanly to black

meta.brief: Plan a ~60-second documentary about Viviana’s book Playful Pottery and what is an important lesson about creativity and kindness the book aims to show.
meta.guidance:
High-Level Story / Structure 
Start with an introduction of the artist and immediately introduce the title of the book. Then, add some footage of her playing with the clay and painting. Lastly, explain the reason she wrote the book and the meaning behind it. The sound will be chill and upbeat without lyrics. 

5 Requirements

1. The clip "slow smile" will begin the video.

2. The clip "shaping clay on the wheel" will come after the clip "I hope the book provides to its readers at, um, like a good reference for just general, um, clay knowledge..".

3. The music will only play when Viviana is not speaking.

4. The video will end with the clip "leaving".

5. The clip "handl paint" will come after the "But also, I really want people to be creative and be kind to themselves."
